review: Static raw-IR/source adjudication; no compilation or native execution performed in this review.
common_findings: No added class .def load guards in these ten cases (counts by exact global symbol unchanged).
No unresolved direct calls in candidate IR. The only broad-token unmatched symbols were @list/@slot occurring in metadata strings, not linker references.
Removed definition/call sites follow the newly lazy imported-specialmethod reachability, with associated constructor/helper discovery renumbering.
No strengthened allocation attributes found. Drops in allockind/pys_new occur with removed unused Counter constructors in cases01404 and01411.

All retained candidate function bodies match baseline bodies after explicit generated-symbol identity mapping and exact string/recursive-metadata expansion. This is a supplementary explanation only; raw oracle evidence was not changed.

cases.explanation: Deferred imported deque methods remove uncalled bool/copy/repr/reversed helpers and the list-input constructor used only by those helpers. The empty-input constructor changes from __init__.2 to __init__.1 and Queue.pending.factory calls the matching body. String deque specialization renumbers 3 to 2; call sites and iterator methods follow. Dataclass field/default-factory call ordering and method sizes are unchanged.

Uncalled deque bool/copy/len/reversed and associated copy/list-input constructor are no longer emitted. Empty-input constructor changes __init__.2 to __init__.1; Queue.values.factory follows it. The two fresh queues, extension, popleft and repr paths remain emitted.

String-deque constructors for list input and string input exchange __init__.1/__init__.2; main's string call and mods.abcuse.queue's list call switch consistently. Int deque specialization changes 3 to 2. Only uncalled string-deque bool/copy/len/reversed methods disappear; imports and initialization remain.

Deque specialization indices shift 5->4, 7->6 and 13->12 as eager annotation-time discovery is removed. Two uncalled deque-1 methods (__copy__, __reversed__) disappear; retained same-symbol method lengths are unchanged.

Deque specialization indices shift 3->2 and 12->11. Deque-1 constructor instance numbering permutes across list, tuple, range and empty-tuple inputs with corresponding call sites. Four unused bool/copy/reversed helpers disappear.

Counter specializations shift 8->6,15->13,22->20. Constructor/update/_count_elements template instances reorder with their call sites. Total definitions, IR line count, runtime-call inventory and allocation-attribute counts remain unchanged.

Deferred unused imported Counter/OrderedDict/defaultdict methods and transitively required helper instances disappear (30 definitions net). Remaining specialization and update/factory-repr instance numbers reorder. One pys_new/allockind site disappears with an unused Counter constructor; main retains all five allocation-attribute sites. Exact body/callee-graph matching accounts for all 442 candidate bodies; baseline-only material comprises 28 dead methods and two orphan duplicate counting helper instances.

Fifteen unused implicit special methods across annotation-created Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict and deque disappear. Defaultdict constructor and shared update/count/factory-repr instance numbers reorder. All eight allocation-attribute sites remain in the same method families.

Unused Counter/defaultdict methods and transitively required counting helpers disappear (18 definitions net); retained Counter4->2/defaultdict4->3 specializations and generic helpers renumber. One unused Counter constructor's pys_new/allockind site disappears; seven main allocation sites and OrderedDict union sites remain. Exact body/callee-graph matching maps 185 baseline bodies onto all 183 candidate bodies; 16 dead methods and two merged duplicate helper instances explain the net decrease.

Only uncalled Counter.__reversed__ disappears (one definition and its list allocation); other changes are referenced string/function/TBAA ordering. The promoting-integer operations and all nine allocation-attribute sites remain.
